# Dorina Tóth

> Portfolio of Tóth Dorina Ildikó, software developer (AI and backend). Work areas: AI systems in Python (LLM, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, OCR, document processing) and backend development. Bilingual site: English (default) and Hungarian under /hu/.

## Pages

- [Home](https://drntth.github.io/): about, stack, certificates, contact
- [Projects](https://drntth.github.io/projects/): selected finished projects with goal, solution, result and technologies
- [Thesis project: language models in project management](https://drntth.github.io/projects/thesis-langmodels-project-management/): Django web application with Hugging Face language models, Docker, unit and Cypress tests
- [Technologies](https://drntth.github.io/technologies/): knowledge map of technologies and concepts, connected to languages, projects and research
- [Research](https://drntth.github.io/research/): research notes tied to concrete project needs
- [Method](https://drntth.github.io/method/): how an idea becomes a finished project and how research stays focused
